## Summary

- evaluate generic ToonLit under directional, point, and spot lights through the shared material fragment stage
- make directional color, intensity, and CSM visibility drive toon ramp and compact specular response
- keep one material shadow floor so additional local lights do not stack dark terms
- soften the compact specular band and add a fixed-camera GPU regression for point/spot ToonLit
- preserve the public Material, serialization, Stable ID, importer, outline, and sphere-map contracts
